title: MIPS: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Reinforcement Learning for Large Outcome Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.19457v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expected-reward maximization in reinforcement learning concentrates probability mass on a few outcomes, even in tasks that require many distinct, high-quality solutions, a failure known as mode collapse. Inverse Probability Scaling (IPS) counters this in group-based policy gradients such as GRPO by dividing each reward by the outcome's probability, estimated from its frequency within the sampled group. When the outcome space is large relative to the group, outcomes rarely repeat and these estimates become uninformative. Since an outcome can be constructed along many trajectories, its probability is a sum over all of them, and computing it directly is intractable. We propose Marginal IPS (MIPS), which performs marginal evaluation by combining the sampled trajectory with a learned model of the trajectories that lead to each outcome. On Hypergrids, where the exact sampling distribution is computable, MIPS stays near the reward-distribution

translated_title: MIPS：在大结果空间中缓解强化学习的模式崩塌
translated_abstract: 强化学习中的期望奖励最大化会将概率质量集中在少数几个结果上，即使在需要许多不同、高质量解的任务中也是如此，这种失败被称为模式崩塌。逆概率缩放在基于组的策略梯度方法（如GRPO）中，通过将每个奖励除以该结果的概率来对抗这一问题，该概率由其在采样组内的出现频率估计得出。然而，当结果空间相对于组规模较大时，结果很少重复出现，这些估计便失去了信息量。由于一个结果可以沿着许多不同的轨迹构造出来，其概率是所有这些轨迹概率的总和，直接计算是不可行的。我们提出了边际IPS（MIPS），它通过将采样轨迹与一个学习到的、通向每个结果的轨迹模型相结合，来执行边际评估。在可以精确计算采样分布的Hypergrids任务上，MIPS保持接近奖励分布……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MIPS方法，通过将采样轨迹与学习到的轨迹模型相结合进行边际概率评估，解决了大结果空间强化学习中因结果稀疏导致IPS概率估计失效、从而无法有效缓解模式崩塌的问题。
